descriptor: Warehouse floor heatmap for pick activity

voice.summary: Talks like a floor supervisor on a radio: short, factual and in the present tense. It names aisles, shifts and seconds, and flags congestion before anyone has to ask.
dos: Name the aisle, shift and metric in every message
Use imperative verbs like move, swap and check
Keep numbers first and units close
donts: Do not soften a problem with hedging
Do not use consulting phrases like optimise throughput

taglines: See where the picks are hot
Every aisle, every hour, on one floor
Cut the walk, lift the picks
boilerplate: STOCKROOM is a warehouse analytics view for the Brightwater distribution centre that maps pick activity by aisle and hour so supervisors can reduce travel time and congestion.

microcopy.error: Floor data unavailable. Check the connection.
microcopy.empty: No picks recorded for this shift.

logo.note: A plain cube suggests stock, boxes and bays, and holds up in all capitals.
